title: Skin Care for Thiruvananthapuram Weather: A Routine for Year-Round Heat, Humidity and Two Monsoons
ex: Warm and humid all year with two rainy seasons: a simple skin care routine for people living in Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum).
rt: Skin Care for Thiruvananthapuram Weather: Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Thiruvananthapuram weather: light layers for year-round humidity, daily sunscreen, two monsoons, AC offices and beach days in Trivandrum.
quick: Thiruvananthapuram is warm and humid almost all year, with the southwest monsoon from about June to September and the northeast monsoon in October and November. Keep a gentle face wash, a light moisturiser and broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning, and use a thin layer of night cream, a little more only in AC rooms.
facts: Trivandrum is on the coast at the southern tip of Kerala and has no real winter
March to May are the hottest, most humid months
It gets rain from both the southwest and northeast monsoons
December to February is the driest, most comfortable stretch
